Hi all — planning a compact, staggered virtual full-loop for Nora (Senior Infra Engineer). Goal: keep total candidate time under 2.5 hours and give interviewers 10–15 minute switch windows so we can do a quick async debrief. Proposed slots (all PT):

1) System design (infra) — 9:45–10:25 (40m) — Rishi
2) Backend + APIs — 10:35–11:05 (30m) — Karthik
3) Culture + cross-team fit — 11:15–11:35 (20m) — Laura
4) Hiring manager / roadmap discussion — 11:45–12:10 (25m) — Jordan

Buffers of 10 minutes between to reduce context switch friction. After the loop, please add short notes into the shared Panel Pack (link below) by EOD — we will run an async debrief thread and aim to sync any conflicting signals tomorrow morning.

Attachments: panel_pack_compact.pdf, candidate_prep_brief.docx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PanelPackShared
Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-virtual-fullloop

Nora — let me know if any of these windows conflict with your availability above. If the earlier morning is better, we can shift everything earlier by 90 minutes.

Thanks — Ava
